Step into the dark... if you dare! The Haunted Tunnel is open, and a thrilling ride awaits you this Halloween. Navigate through shadowy tracks filled with trick-or-treat surprises and blast your way through the ghostly tracks!!

Be sure to update to the latest version of Toy Blast for the newest content. Every 2 weeks, we bring you 50 NEW LEVELS!

Come and have fun!
